statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: src/ui/compositions/Headers/Headers.tsx, src/stories/compositions/Cards.stories.tsx. Do not edit forbidden paths: package.json, package-lock.json, src/App.tsx, src/ui/primitives/**, src/data/**, scripts/**.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved after narrowing the selector to component:HeaderAuth, the base component that owns authenticated navigation; it resolves uniquely to production Headers.tsx.
